recommendation_summary: Set up a single hosted heartbeat monitor that the cron job pings only on successful exit, which emails the user when the daily signal misses its deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging, Docker, and a Synology service for this problem.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends email only after reaching its summary step, so an early crash is silent.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts: four startup failures, no email, and no independent alert.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert, keeps the existing email, and explicitly rejects central logs, Docker and the Synology.
